reference.observations: Official exterior photograph shows a long charcoal south facade, large pale geometric marks, recessed dark openings and shallow projecting entrance canopies. The roof and northern earth slope are independently visible in BVV DOP20/DGM1. Reference pixels are not redistributed.

qualification: Experimental source-informed exterior of the main surveyed CALA volume only. Eight BVV walls and six original roof triangles fix the envelope; roof pixels are public DOP20. Charcoal/light finishes, pale geometric motifs, opening positions, glazing, frames and canopies are approximate interpretations of an oblique official photograph, not a measured facade survey. Adjacent survey volumes and source-backed terrain are preserved. No interiors or redistributed reference-photo pixels. Ground joins and native visual acceptance are required before release.
